pluginId: String,

        runtime.withOriginalPluginAdmission(current, revision) {
            persistBiliPaiJsParamValues(context, current.manifest.id, module, paramValues)
        }

                expectedRevision = revision

ensureActive()
            if (!owned() || loadGeneration.get() != generation) return@launch
            isLoading = false
            result.onSuccess

val nextPage = page + 1
        val generation = loadGeneration.get()
        val capturedValues = paramValues.toMap()
        loadJob = scope.launch {
            val result = runtime.loadOriginalModuleItems(

capturedValues,
                    page = nextPage,
                    loadedCount = items.size
                ),
                expectedRevision = revision

ensureActive()
            if (!owned() || loadGeneration.get() != generation) return@launch
            isLoadingMore = false
            result.onSuccess

isLoading = true
        isLoadingMore = false
        errorMessage = null
LaunchedEffect(selectedModule, installed?.enabled, revision)

                        imagePreview = resolveBiliPaiJsImagePreviewRequest(images, index, rect)
